answer: Agents must map a unique canyon geological survey to earn admission, with each unit assigned via a dune coordinate system. One honest agent spends 1,000 cycles, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000 units to reach the same dune site. The verifier checks if the canyon input matches existing records, applying a tide of penalties for replay errors. Assuming no hardware pool can traverse the shifting tide, the system effectively limits fakes.
